title: M-APSK Demodulator Baseband
text: M 进制振幅相移键控 (APSK) 解调，输入 2 路、输出 1 路；按 {Symbol mapping} 指定符号映射；{Constellation points per circle} 指定每个 PSK 环的星座点数、{Radius of each circle} 指定每个 PSK 环的半径、{Phase offset of each circle (rad)} 指定每个 PSK 环的相位偏移、{Custom symbol mapping}、{Output type} 输出类型 Integer、{Decision type} 指定解调判决类型 Hard、{Noise variance source} 指定噪声方差源、{Noise variance} 指定噪声方差、{Output data type} 输出数据类型、{Simulate using} 指定要运行的仿真类型 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: In
ports.summary: APSK 已调信号 scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Var
ports.summary: 噪声方差 positive scalar | vector of positive values

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: 解调信号 scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Constellation points per circle
params.values: 每个 PSK 环的星座点数 [4,12] (default) | vector

params.name: Radius of each circle
params.values: 每个 PSK 环的半径 [0.5,1] (default) | vector

params.name: Phase offset of each circle (rad)
params.values: 每个 PSK 环的相位偏移 [pi/4,pi/12] (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Symbol mapping
params.values: 符号映射 Auto (default) | Contourwise-gray | Gray | User-defined

params.name: Decision type
params.values: 解调判决类型 Hard decision (default) | Log-likelihood ratio | Approximate log-likelihood ratio

params.name: Noise variance source
params.values: 噪声方差源 Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Noise variance
params.values: 噪声方差 1 (default) | positive scalar | vector of positive values

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 要运行的仿真类型 Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
